description: This file defines the FnStream class, which is a flexible stream implementation allowing customization via function hashes, primarily for testing and extending stream behavior.

classes.name: FnStream
classes.description: A dynamic stream class that allows for custom method implementations using a hash of functions, facilitating testing and extension without creating concrete subclasses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an FnStream instance with a hash of method names to callables, dynamically creating corresponding methods.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Handles access to methods not explicitly implemented, throws exception if called.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up by calling the close function if defined when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of FnStream instances, throwing an exception.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Creates a new FnStream that decorates a given StreamInterface with additional or overridden methods.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the stream, handling exceptions that may occur.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the underlying stream by invoking the user-defined close function.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying stream, returning the result of the user-defined detach function.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached its end.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seek to a position within the stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata about the stream or specific metadata key.
